column3: “Tribute” specifies the lambs, which are plural instead of singular; “in the desert” replaces the direction toward the wilderness.
The dispatched nest becomes birds pushed out of a nest.
“For Moab” makes Moab the beneficiary instead of the addressee.
“Fallen silent” interprets the falling of the shout.
“Grapes” stands for the wine being trodden.
“Heart laments” replaces the sounding of the inward parts.
